title: Dice Semimetric Losses: Optimizing the Dice Score with Soft Labels
mechanism: Dice loss that equals soft Dice on hard labels but is minimised at prediction = target for soft labels.
adaptation: Drop-in replacement for the house soft Dice in every soft-target arm (KD, SVLS, GeoLS, SoftSeg, dilated labels); run DML vs house soft Dice on the same soft targets to show whether the house loss breaks.
min_experiment: Inside the SVLS arm: SVLS+DML vs SVLS+house soft Dice, 5 v 5. Metric crack IoU; kill if DML - soft Dice < +0.012 (then the soft-Dice issue does not matter here).
evidence: R (web summary): better Dice and calibration than soft Dice with soft labels on QUBIQ, LiTS, KiTS; numbers not read.
prior_overlap: Dice on 3 classes (hard labels) n.d.; DML is identical there, so only the soft-label use is open.
